name: grounded
description: Deep opinions from the strongest model, fact-checked by a cheaper one in a separate context. `ask` switches to the top model and writes the opinion as a document you keep discussing; `verify` hands only that document to a read-only Sonnet verifier that extracts the factual claims it rests on and confirms, refutes or marks each one unverifiable with cited evidence — then Fable re-judges every refutation against the citations, revises the document, and a fresh verifier checks the revision — up to three rounds, with repeat refutations escalated to you.
